The grey slice corresponds to the legend label "по-малко от 10" (less than 10), not "между 10 и 20" (between 10 and 20).
The light brown (orange) slice corresponds to the legend label "между 10 и 20" (between 10 and 20), not "по-малко от 10" (less than 10).

The description associates the category "по-малко от 10" with a value of approximately 10%. However, the chart shows that the category "по-малко от 10" corresponds to the grey slice, which has a value of 26.2%.
